run_preprocess_ef_cli: run the preprocess_ef script with --data-path and --out-path to create LMDB files from extxyz trajectory files
run_preprocess_ef_with_edges: run the preprocess_ef script with --get-edges flag to store edge indices in the LMDB output
run_preprocess_ef_multiprocess: run the preprocess_ef script with --num-workers to parallelize feature extraction across multiple processes
run_preprocess_ef_test_data: run the preprocess_ef script with --test-data flag to process test data without energy or force labels
run_preprocess_ef_ref_energy: run the preprocess_ef script with --ref-energy flag to subtract reference energies from frame energies
